Name: IT General Controls (ITGC) for Oracle Fusion ERP & HCM
Description: Exhaustive IT General Controls (ITGC) framework aligned with Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404, PCAOB AS 2201, and the COSO Internal Control Integrated Framework for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, HCM, and SCM. This is a platform-defined control set aligned with the named real regulatory framework's known objectives, not a verbatim transcription of an official published checklist — organizations achieve SOX 404 / SOC 1 / SoD compliance through their own internal controls program, not a single external document.

Requirements.Name: Privileged Superuser & Implementation Role Governance
Requirements.Description: Implementation consultant roles (Application Implementation Consultant) and superuser roles must be revoked from all operational accounts post-go-live.

Requirements.Name: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) on Administrative Accounts
Requirements.Description: MFA is strictly enforced on all administrative, privileged, and financial execution accounts accessing Oracle Security Console or IDCS.

Requirements.Name: Periodic User Access Reviews & Inactive Account Cleanup (>90 Days)
Requirements.Description: User accounts and privileged role assignments are periodically reviewed; dormant accounts with no activity for >90 days are deactivated.

Requirements.Name: Segregation of Incompatible Duties (SoD) Enforcement
Requirements.Description: Business and administrative duty roles are segregated across financial cycles to prevent single-point execution of fraud.

Requirements.Name: Least Privilege Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
Requirements.Description: Users are assigned only the minimum job roles and duty privileges required for their documented business function.

Requirements.Name: Password Complexity, Expiration, and Lockout Parameters
Requirements.Description: Oracle Identity Domain password policies enforce minimum length, rotation cycles, and lockout on repeated failed attempts.

Requirements.Name: Emergency Break-Glass Account Governance & Monitoring
Requirements.Description: Emergency break-glass accounts are maintained in a vaulted state, require dual authorization to check out, and alert immediately on login.

Requirements.Name: User Termination & Immediate Access Revocation
Requirements.Description: Terminated employee access is revoked from Oracle Fusion Applications and IDCS within 24 hours of notification from HR.

Requirements.Name: Sandbox Publication and Page Customization Approval
Requirements.Description: Changes to user interfaces, descriptive flexfields, and page layouts via Oracle Sandboxes require formal review and approval prior to publication.

Requirements.Name: FastFormula and Business Rules Change Management
Requirements.Description: Calculations and business logic implemented via FastFormula in Payroll, Compensation, and Benefits are subject to formal change control and testing.

Requirements.Name: Environment Separation & Migration Controls
Requirements.Description: Development and Test environments are segregated from Production; direct configuration changes in Production are strictly restricted.

Requirements.Name: Enterprise Scheduler Service (ESS) Job Monitoring
Requirements.Description: Scheduled batch jobs for financial close, payment file generation, and GL posting are monitored for failures, exceptions, and restarts.

Requirements.Name: Data Backup, Disaster Recovery & High Availability
Requirements.Description: Oracle Cloud infrastructure automated backups and disaster recovery RTO/RPO metrics are validated and tested periodically.

Requirements.Name: Audit Trail Configuration for Financial Objects
Requirements.Description: Oracle Fusion object-level audit policies are actively enabled for General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Receivables, and Supplier records.

Requirements.Name: Complete Financial Audit Trail Coverage & Attributes
Requirements.Description: Audit policies capture both insert, update, and delete actions with before-and-after values for key SOX-relevant financial attributes.

Requirements.Name: Security Console Audit Trail & Role Modification Tracking
Requirements.Description: Changes to role hierarchies, duty privilege assignments, and security profiles within the Security Console are recorded in the audit trail.

Requirements.Name: Audit Trail Tamper-Resistance & 365-Day Retention
Requirements.Description: Audit logs are retained for at least 365 days and protected from unauthorized modification or truncation.

Requirements.Name: Corporate Network Perimeter & IP Allowlisting
Requirements.Description: Access to administrative interfaces and ERP applications is restricted to approved corporate networks and VPN egress points.

Requirements.Name: OAuth Integration Security & Scoped API Least Privilege
Requirements.Description: OAuth Confidential Applications and REST API clients are granted only the minimum required scopes and audited regularly.

Requirements.Name: Inbound / Outbound ERP Data Transmission Encryption
Requirements.Description: All financial data transmissions via B2B gateways, payment gateways, and banking SFTP interfaces use TLS 1.2+ or PGP encryption.
